battle.name: 越南戰爭
battle.theater: 越南中部高原與中部海岸
battle.brief: 1959年南越戰事升級，越共游擊隊與南越軍在中南部爭奪據點；美軍自1964年大規模介入，到1975年4月西貢陷落，戰事延續十六年。UH-1「休伊」1959年成軍，1962年3月隨醫療後送隊進入南越，1965年4月首批77架UH-1D抵達戰區，成為空騎兵突擊與後送的骨幹。

kit.name: UH-1「休伊」直升機
kit.history: UH-1為美軍首款大批量使用的戰術通用直升機，主要負責兵員與物資運輸、空中偵察及近距離支援任務，並成為越戰標誌性空中平台。

countries: 北越方面是越南民主共和國：胡志明於1945年9月5日在河內宣布建國，黨政核心為越南共產黨，國務由總理范文同主持，軍事則歸人民軍總司令部指揮，1973年由文進勇接任。北方以越戰為名，把全國武裝力量整合為正規軍、游擊隊與民兵三層體系，前線由南方游擊隊指揮部運作；1960年代前半期阮志清與長春等人提出的游擊戰理論，是南方游擊隊能夠長期存續的理論基礎。1960年12月南越的南方解放陣線成立，越南人民解放軍在形式上統一了南方武裝力量；1960年代後期北越以正規化主力團大量南下，戰線由山區推向沿海平原與湄公河三角洲。南越方面是越南共和國：1955年10月吳庭琰在西貢成立政府，首都與主要兵源集中在南部，國軍主體是南越陸軍的步兵師、裝甲師與空降部隊，1960年代中後期擴編至十餘個步兵師；軍事指揮由總統府與參謀總部掌握，總統更迭頻繁，1963年吳庭琰遇刺後由阮高其、阮文興、阮玉壽、阮玉、阮文善先後擔任，1973年阮文善接任，直到1975年4月西貢陷落。美國方面：1961年先成立駐越美軍顧問團，由哈金斯少將主持；1964年戰區指揮統一為美國駐越南軍援司令部，首任司令為威斯特摩蘭中將，1968年艾伯姆斯中將、1971年韋恩德中將相繼接掌；美軍地面部隊分屬第三軍（西貢以東）、第四軍（中部高原）與第二軍（北部），航空兵力由第七航空隊統轄，第十二航空隊負責支援南越空軍，B-52轟炸則多自泰國與關島基地起飛。北盟方面：蘇聯以米格-21戰鬥機、S-75防空導彈、T-54坦克、火炮、卡車與顧問團支援北越；中國自1960年代起派遣軍事顧問與援越部隊進入北越及老撾方向，提供炮兵、防空、後勤與訓練協助，並在1972年後派駐援越部隊。蘇中在越南的競爭，是北越得以長期維持高強度消耗的關鍵外部條件。
countriesEn: On the northern side was the Democratic Republic of Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh proclaimed it in Hanoi on 5 September 1945, the party and state were centred on the Vietnamese Communist Party, civilian government was run by Prime Minister Pham Van Dong, and the armed forces came under the General Staff of the People's Army, handed to Van Tien Dung in 1973. In the north the war was fought under the banner of Viet Nam chien tranh, which fused the country's armed strength into a three-tier system of regular troops, guerrillas and militia, with the southern front run by the guerrilla command. The guerrilla doctrine articulated in the early 1960s by Nguyen Chi Thanh and Truong Chinh supplied the ideological basis on which the southern guerrillas survived for so long. The National Liberation Front of South Vietnam was founded in December 1960 and the People's Liberation Army of Vietnam formally unified the armed struggle in the south; from the late 1960s the north pushed regularised main-force regiments southward in large numbers, moving the front out of the mountains towards the coastal plains and the Mekong Delta. On the southern side was the Republic of Vietnam: Ngo Dinh Diem founded the government at Saigon in October 1955, the capital and the bulk of the manpower lay in the south, and the National Army of the Republic of Vietnam was built around infantry divisions, armoured divisions and airborne units, expanded to more than a dozen infantry divisions by the middle and late 1960s. The president and the Joint Chiefs of Staff exercised operational command, and the presidency changed hands repeatedly: after Diem was assassinated in 1963 came Nguyen Cao Ky, Tran Van Huong, Nguyen Ngoc Tho, Nguyen Ngoc and Nguyen Van Thieu in turn, with Nguyen Van Thieu taking office in 1973 and remaining until the fall of Saigon in April 1975. The United States first created a military assistance advisory group in Vietnam in 1961 under Lieutenant General Paul Harkins; in 1964 theatre command was unified as the Military Assistance Command, Vietnam, with General William Westmoreland as its first commander, followed by General Abrams in 1968 and General Weyand in 1971. American ground forces belonged to the Third Army east of Saigon, the Fourth Army in the Central Highlands and the Second Army in the north; air power was run by the Seventh Air Force, with the Twelfth Air Force supporting the South Vietnamese, and B-52 strikes were launched from bases in Thailand and from Guam. The Soviet Union supplied North Vietnam with MiG-21 fighters, S-75 surface-to-air missiles, T-54 tanks, artillery, trucks and adviser teams; from the 1960s China sent military advisers and support units into North Vietnam and towards Laos, providing artillery, air defence, logistics and training, and stationed aid units in North Vietnam after 1972. The Sino-Soviet competition in Vietnam was the crucial external condition that let the north sustain such high-intensity attrition.
people: 北越與越共一方：胡志明自1945年起以民族主義與社會主義雙重身分領導抗法與統一事業，1950年代奠邊府戰役中仍在後方策劃，1960年代則推動以北方實力支援南方鬥爭的方針；武元甲指揮人民軍攻下奠邊府，是北方正規作戰能力的建立者，後任國防部長；黎德壽自1968年起代表北越同美方談判，1973年參與簽署巴黎和平協議；范文同任北越總理，1973年出任黨中央書記；文進勇在1973年出任人民軍總司令，策劃1972年復活節攻勢的作戰部署；黎筍自1960年出任黨中央總書記，主導對南政策；阮志清與長春在1960年代前半期就游擊戰路線提出主張，一派強調以游擊戰長期消耗敵人，一派主張加快正規化，這場黨內論爭最終以全面正規化告終。南越與美國一方：吳庭琰拒絕日內瓦協議所確定的全國統一選舉，1963年11月1日與總統府軍事幕僚同乘UH-1直升機在宮外遇刺身亡；阮高其、阮文興、阮玉壽、阮玉、阮文善先後執掌總統府，1973年阮文善出任總統並主持與北越的談判。美國方面，總統強生在1965年批准滾動雷鳴行動並增派地面部隊，南越戰區司令威斯特摩蘭中將推動搜索與摧毀戰術；艾伯姆斯中將1968年接任後把兵力轉向北部與柬埔寨方向；韋恩德中將在1971年主持美軍體制的撤出調整；國防部長麥克納馬拉1961年上任後推動戰爭特種化與美軍逐步撤出，1967年更提出分批撤出美軍，1968年由施萊辛格接任並把重心轉向談判。其他人方面，南越第21師師長阮友安在1972年9月依靠UH-1空運部隊反攻廣治，一度奪回陣地；中共中央派出的軍事顧問陳賡在河內擔任軍委代表，協調援越物資與部隊；美軍飛行員與地勤在Dust Off醫療後送體系中運作，成為這場戰爭最被記住的群體之一。
peopleEn: On the northern and southern insurgent side: Ho Chi Minh led both the anti-French struggle and the cause of national unity from 1945, still planning from the rear during the Dien Bien Phu campaign of the 1950s and pushing the policy of using northern strength to support the southern fight in the 1960s. Vo Nguyen Giap commanded the People's Army in the taking of Dien Bien Phu, established the regular combat capacity of the north and afterwards served as defence minister. Le Duc Tho represented North Vietnam in negotiations with the Americans from 1968 and took part in signing the Paris Peace Accords in 1973. Pham Van Dong was prime minister of North Vietnam and became party first secretary in 1973. Van Tien Dung became chief of the general staff of the People's Army in 1973 and planned the operational layout of the 1972 Easter Offensive. Le Duan was first secretary of the party from 1960 and directed policy towards the south. Nguyen Chi Thanh and Truong Chinh debated the line on guerrilla warfare in the early 1960s, one school stressing protracted attrition by guerrillas and the other urging faster regularisation, and the internal debate ended with full regularisation. On the South Vietnamese and American side: Ngo Dinh Diem refused the nationwide unification elections set out in the Geneva Accords and was killed on 1 November 1963 together with his military aide when their helicopter was fired on outside the palace. Nguyen Cao Ky, Tran Van Huong, Nguyen Ngoc Tho, Nguyen Ngoc and Nguyen Van Thieu successively held the presidency, and Nguyen Van Thieu became president in 1973 and led the talks with North Vietnam. In the United States, President Johnson approved Rolling Thunder and expanded the ground deployment in 1965, while theatre commander General William Westmoreland drove the search-and-destroy doctrine; General Abrams took over in 1968 and turned American effort towards the north and Cambodia; General Weyand ran the drawdown adjustments from 1971. Defence Secretary McNamara took office in 1961, pushed the war towards specialisation and gradual withdrawal of American troops, and proposed the phased troop withdrawal of 1967; he was succeeded in 1968 by Schlesinger, who shifted the emphasis towards negotiation. Among the rest, ARVN 21st Division commander Nguyen Huu An used airlifted troops delivered by UH-1 to counterattack at Quang Tri in September 1972 and briefly retaken ground. Chen Geng served as the party military representative in Hanoi and coordinated aid materiel and units. American pilots and crews ran the Dust Off aeromedical evacuation system, and they remain one of the most remembered groups of the war.
kits: 卡面兵器是UH-1休伊通用直升機，正式名稱Bell UH-1 Iroquois，1956年完成首飛，1959年以HU-1A之名進入美軍服役，1962年改稱UH-1，暱稱休伊正來自HU-1這個官方編號的念法。它是美軍第一款渦輪軸心式的量產通用直升機，也是越戰最具代表性的空中平台：單主旋翼、尾槳置於尾梁末端，主旋翼直徑約十四點六公尺，UH-1H裝萊康明T53-L-13渦輪軸心發動機，額定一千四百軸馬力，最大起飛重量約四千三百公斤，實用載重約二千一百公斤。機艙內可塞十三名乘員，落地即散開，是空騎兵部隊的基本單位；常見武裝是艙門的M60或M134 7.62毫米機槍、20毫米M24與M85炮門以及火箭發射巢，越戰後期曾試裝XM26拖莢式發射架發射TOW反戰車導彈，1972年復活節攻勢期間的試射中，162發導彈命中151發。由於北越防空火力日密，UH-1B與UH-1C的武裝步槍兵角色在1967年至1968年間被AH-1眼鏡蛇攻擊直升機取代，UH-1轉回運輸與後送主業，但近距火力支援仍由它承擔。除UH-1外，雙方主要裝備包括美軍的F-4幽靈II戰鬥機、A-1空中鯊攻擊機、OV-10莫霍克武裝觀察機、O-1輕型觀察機、C-123供應者與C-130大力神運輸機、B-52同溫層堡壘轟炸機；步兵武器以M16A1、M1加蘭特半自動步槍、M14與M60通用機槍為主；裝甲車有M113裝甲人員運輸車與M60A1主力坦克；南越軍同樣使用美製M16與M113；北越與越共以AK-47、56式衝鋒槍、蘇製RPK輕機槍為主，配備T-54坦克、PT-76輕型坦克、122毫米榴彈砲與BMP裝甲步兵車。運輸方面，UH-1承擔營連級的垂直輸送，105毫米M114榴彈砲可由貨鉤吊運；C-130與C-123負責戰區內與戰區間的空運；公路與鐵路承擔大批量地面補給，越南的1號公路與9號公路是南北方向最脆弱也最關鍵的補給線。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the UH-1 Huey general-purpose helicopter, formally the Bell UH-1 Iroquois, which first flew in 1956 and entered American service in 1959 as the HU-1A, was redesignated UH-1 in 1962, and took its nickname from the way the original designation was spoken. It was the first mass-produced turbine-powered general-purpose helicopter in American service and the most recognisable air platform of the war: a single main rotor with the tail rotor on the end of the tail boom, a main rotor diameter of about 14.6 metres, the UH-1H powered by a Lycoming T53-L-13 turboshaft rated at 1,400 shaft horsepower, a maximum take-off weight of roughly 4,300 kilograms and a useful load of about 2,100 kilograms. Thirteen personnel could be crammed into the cabin and would scatter the instant they touched down, making it the basic unit of the airmobile force. Common armament was M60 or M134 7.62 mm machine guns on the doors, 20 mm M24 and M85 cannon pods, and rocket launchers; late in the war an XM26 pod firing the TOW anti-tank missile was trialled, and in the shots fired during the 1972 Easter Offensive 151 of 162 missiles hit. As North Vietnamese air defences thickened, the armed gunship role of the UH-1B and UH-1C was taken over between 1967 and 1968 by the AH-1 Cobra, and the Huey went back to transport and evacuation, though close air support remained its work. Beyond the UH-1, the principal equipment on both sides included the American F-4 Phantom II fighter, the A-1 Skyraider attack aircraft, the OV-10 Mohawk armed observation aircraft, the O-1 light observation aircraft, the C-123 Provider and C-130 Hercules transports and the B-52 Stratofortress bomber. Infantry weapons centred on the M16A1, the M1 Garand semi-automatic rifle, the M14 and the M60 general purpose machine gun; armoured vehicles included the M113 armoured personnel carrier and the M60A1 main battle tank; the South Vietnamese army was likewise equipped with American M16 rifles and M113 carriers, while the Viet Cong and North Vietnamese relied on the AK-47, the Chinese Type 56 submachine gun and the Soviet RPK light machine gun, backed by T-54 tanks, PT-76 light tanks, 122 mm howitzers and BMP infantry fighting vehicles. On the transport side the UH-1 carried the vertical lift of battalion and company size, with 105 mm M114 howitzers slung under the cargo hook; the C-130 and C-123 handled intra-theatre and inter-theatre airlift; roads and railways carried bulk ground supply, and National Route 1 and National Route 9 were the most fragile and most important north-south lines. Against the odds, the UH-1 was the platform that made the airmobile division possible, and it remained in service in the theatre until the American withdrawal.
tactics: 空騎兵戰術是UH-1最吃重的用法，空騎兵師的UH-1按任務分成三種：偵察分隊在目標區外緣低空盤旋，提供情報與壓制火力；運輸分隊把一個排或是一個連一次帶上十餘人升空；火力支援分隊在著陸區周邊以機炮與火箭封住敵方陣地。突擊一個據點通常採連續波次起降：第一波落地即建立警戒，第二波投入增援，最後以熱撤離把傷員與裝備拉回來；若敵火太強或著陸區不可用，則改為倉促撤離，人員先分散到林線再徒步撤出。搜索與摧毀是這一時期美軍的主流戰術，師旅級部隊用UH-1群反覆空運搜索營，進入村落後以班排分散搜索，發現游擊隊集結就呼叫炮兵與空襲；到1970年前後重點轉為清剿與守備，搜索範圍收斂到少數戰略要點。南方游擊隊那邊，組織上分為主力、游擊兵與民兵三層，主力隊在山區叢林保存實力，游擊兵以小組在公路、鐵路與水壩打埋伏、埋地雷、破壞補給線，民兵擔負報信與運輸。北越主力團在1960年代後期開始以營或團為單位沿胡澤明小道與沿海公路南下，雨季用卡車運載作戰部隊，旱季則依賴UH-1與空襲支援。1972年復活節攻勢，北方以炮兵與裝甲先撕開正面，再用步兵佔線，西線廣治一度被拿下，南越第21師靠UH-1空運部隊於9月反攻一度奪回，雙方在山脊僵持到翌年1月。1975年攻勢中，北方奇襲西貢，UH-1與海軍直升機同時執行撤運，把機場與港口的守軍與美僑一批批送走；美軍海軍陸戰隊在4月26日完成撤離，最後一批美軍作戰部隊則於1973年3月29日離開南方。
tacticsEn: Airmobile tactics were where the UH-1 did the heaviest lifting, and the Hueys of an airmobile division were sorted by task. Scout sections loitered at low altitude on the fringe of the objective, providing information and suppressive fire. Transport sections lifted a platoon or a company of a dozen men or more in a single wave. Fire support sections worked the edges of the landing zone, sealing enemy positions with cannon and rockets. Assault on a position was normally run in successive waves: the first wave landed and set up a perimeter, the second reinforced, and the last pulled the wounded and equipment out in a hot extraction. When enemy fire was too heavy or the zone unusable, the troops scattered into the tree line and withdrew on foot in a hasty extraction. Search and destroy was the dominant American tactic of the period, with divisional and corps units airlifting search companies in repeated waves by UH-1; once in a village they dispersed into platoons to sweep, and on finding guerrillas massed they called in artillery and air strikes. Towards 1970 the emphasis shifted to clear and hold, with searching narrowed to a handful of strategic objectives. On the insurgent side the southern guerrillas were organised in three tiers: main-force units preserved their strength in the hills and jungle, guerrillas worked in small teams to ambush convoys along roads, railways and dams, mine the routes and break the supply lines, and militia handled signalling and transport. From the late 1960s the North Vietnamese main-force regiments began moving south in battalion or regimental groups along the Ho Chi Minh Trail and the coastal roads, carried by truck in the wet season and dependent on UH-1 lift and air strike in the dry. In the 1972 Easter Offensive the north opened the front with artillery and armour and then occupied the ground with infantry; Quang Tri fell in the western sector, and the South Vietnamese 21st Division counterattacked in September with airlifted UH-1s and briefly retook it, the two sides then locked along the ridge line until January of the following year. In the 1975 offensive the north struck Saigon by surprise, with UH-1s and naval helicopters running the evacuation together and lifting the garrison of the airfields and the port and American personnel away in batches. The US Marine Corps completed its withdrawal on 26 April, and the last American combat troops left the south on 29 March 1973.
data: 產量與規格：UH-1家族自1960年以來累計生產超過一萬六千架，其中UH-1H一型即達五千四百三十五架，是產量最大的型別，UH-1D生產兩千零八架。越南戰區約部署了七千架UH-1，其中逾三千三百架被判定摧毀或永久損失。兵力方面，美軍在越南的兵力於1968年達到峰值，約五十四萬三千人；1968年美軍年度死亡約一萬六千五百人，其中約九千三百人在南越境內陣亡。整場戰爭美軍死亡約五萬八千二百二十人，受傷以官方口徑約十五萬三千人最常被引述。南越政府軍作戰陣亡常被引述為約五萬八千人，亦有研究估計達二十五萬。北越軍與越共的陣亡人數缺乏可靠記載，各方估計自二十萬至六十萬不等。火力與載荷：美軍在印度支那投放的炸彈總量約三百五十萬噸，其中約二百萬噸落在南越，僅1965年3月到1968年11月的滾動雷鳴一役，出動架次的統計就由數十萬至百萬以上不等；1972年12月的防線II空襲中，B-52連續十日出動，出擊架次逾一千二百架次。飛行與救護：以UH-1為主的空中醫療後送架次普遍引述為超過五十萬次，Dust Off成為通用呼號；全戰役美軍在越南損失的直升機逾兩千架，各型飛機損失約二千二百至二千五百架。1973年1月的巴黎協議換回五百九十一名戰俘，另有約一千二百人列為失蹤。時間與代價：從1959年算到1975年4月30日西貢陷落，戰事歷時約十六年；美軍直接介入約九年（1964年至1973年3月）。美國在1961年至1975年間為此支出的直接軍費約一千一百億至一千二百億美元。
dataEn: Production and specifications: more than 16,000 members of the Iroquois family were built from 1960 onward, the UH-1H alone accounting for 5,435 aircraft and making it by far the most numerous version, while 2,008 UH-1Ds were completed. Around 7,000 Hueys were deployed in the Vietnam theatre, of which more than 3,300 were believed destroyed or permanently lost. In manpower terms, American strength in Vietnam peaked in 1968 at about 543,000 men. American military deaths in 1968 ran to roughly 16,500, of whom about 9,300 were killed in action in South Vietnam. Across the whole war 58,220 Americans died, and the figure most often quoted for wounded is 153,000 on the official count. South Vietnamese government forces are commonly credited with about 58,000 combat deaths, though some studies put the total as high as 250,000. Reliable figures for the dead of the North Vietnamese and Viet Cong do not exist, and estimates run from 200,000 to 600,000. In weight of fire and payload, the United States dropped roughly 3.5 million tons of bombs across Indochina, about 2 million tons of it on South Vietnam; the sorties flown under Rolling Thunder alone, from March 1965 to November 1968, are counted anywhere from several hundred thousand to well over a million. During Linebacker II in December 1972, B-52s flew on ten consecutive days and made more than 1,200 bombing sorties. On flight and rescue, the number of aeromedical evacuation missions flown largely by the UH-1 is commonly given as more than 500,000, with Dust Off becoming the universal call sign. American losses in Vietnam exceeded 2,000 helicopters and between roughly 2,200 and 2,500 aircraft of all types. The Paris agreements of January 1973 returned 591 prisoners of war, with about 1,200 more remaining listed as missing in action. In time and cost: from 1959 to the fall of Saigon on 30 April 1975 the war ran for about sixteen years, and American involvement proper lasted roughly nine years, from 1964 to March 1973. Direct American military expenditure between 1961 and 1975 is put at between 110 and 120 billion dollars.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因疊在一起。最外層是法國在印度支那的殖民戰爭失敗：1946年法國回歸越南，1946年至1954年的第一次印度支那戰爭以奠邊府陷落告終，1954年日內瓦協議把越南暫時劃在十七度線南北，要求停火三年後舉行全國統一選舉；吳庭琰領導的南越政府拒絕這條款，改以保住南越為目標，衝突因此沒有被協議凍結。接著是南方的升級：1959年至1960年，越共在紅河三角洲中部與西原的武裝行動迅速升級，滲透城鎮、襲擊南越軍哨所與小分隊、破壞交通線，1960年9月中部各省相繼遭襲，南越政府稱之為特種戰爭，美軍顧問團由數百人增至數千人，1961年11月美軍特種部隊進入南越展開大規模搜索行動，開啟了美軍直接作戰的第一步。美國介入的決策背景是對共產主義擴張的判斷：艾森豪威爾政府時期的顛覆風險評估、1961年古巴豬灣事件，以及馬丁尼茲事件的調查報告，都讓華盛頓相信南越一旦淪陷，鄰國會連鎖倒向北越。1964年8月的東京灣事件中，美軍護衛驅逐艦在北部外海遭北越魚雷艇攻擊受傷，隨後的報復性空襲擊落了北越軍機；美國隨即與南越簽訂共同防禦條約，國會通過東京灣決議授權總統動用武力，1965年3月2日滾動雷鳴行動開始，3月8日第一批海軍陸戰隊在峴港登陸，同年秋天美軍兵力急增至近二十萬人，戰爭由特種戰爭轉為大規模常規戰爭。北越的戰略目標則是要以持久戰消耗南方與美國的資源，把南越政府與軍隊拖入無法承擔的消耗，最終逼美國撤走，並與蘇越支持的其他戰線配合。
causeEn: Several layers of cause were stacked on top of one another. The outermost was the failure of the French colonial war in Indochina: France returned to Vietnam in 1946, and the First Indochina War of 1946 to 1954 ended with the fall of Dien Bien Phu. The 1954 Geneva Accords divided Vietnam provisionally along the seventeenth parallel and called for a ceasefire of three years followed by nationwide unification elections. The South Vietnamese government under Ngo Dinh Diem refused that clause and made the preservation of South Vietnam its aim, so the conflict was never frozen by the agreement. Next came the escalation in the south: between 1959 and 1960 the armed activity of the Viet Cong rose sharply across the central Mekong delta and the Central Highlands, infiltrating towns, striking South Vietnamese outposts and small patrols and breaking the lines of communication. In September 1960 the central provinces were hit in turn, and the South Vietnamese government called this a special war. The American advisory group grew from a few hundred men to several thousand, and in November 1961 American special forces entered South Vietnam in large-scale search operations, opening the first chapter of direct American combat. The background to the American decision was a judgement about communist expansion: the risk-of-subversion assessment of the Eisenhower years, the Bay of Pigs in 1961 and the investigation of the Martinez incident all convinced Washington that a South Vietnamese collapse would push neighbouring states toward North Vietnam. In the Gulf of Tonkin incident of August 1964 an American escort destroyer was attacked by North Vietnamese torpedo boats off the northern coast, and the retaliatory strikes that followed shot down North Vietnamese aircraft. Washington then signed a mutual defence treaty with South Vietnam, Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin resolution authorising the president to use force, Rolling Thunder began on 2 March 1965, and the first Marine landing at Da Nang came on 8 March. American strength climbed steeply during the autumn of that year, and the special war turned into a large conventional war. The North Vietnamese strategic aim was to wear down southern and American resources through a war of attrition, to drag the South Vietnamese government and army into a level of expenditure they could not sustain, to force an American withdrawal, and to coordinate with the other fronts supported by Moscow and Hanoi.
impact: 這場戰爭改變的不只是越南。對美國而言，越戰是一場沒有速勝方案卻必須持續投入的消耗戰，1970年代初的反戰運動、1971年五角大樓文件被公開、1973年美軍改為全志願役、1980年代關於指揮官是否有權下達違憲命令的費城兵營案，以及長期的越戰症候群，都是這段經歷的直接產物；美軍的海外干預理論也從全面介入改為強調低強度、非戰爭作戰與縱深防禦的溫伯格主義。武器發展上，越戰催生了精確導引炸彈、雷射導引與電視導引的光學吊艙、無人機偵察與地空協同火力的現代化，大量UH-1也讓直升機作戰從輔助手段變成軍隊結構的基礎。對北越與南越而言，1975年之後的統一並不意味著戰爭結束，1978年越南北進柬埔寨與美國交戰，直接導致1979年中國的對越自衛反擊戰以及中越關係長時間惡化；蘇聯趁勢在1972年與1975年兩次大規模攻勢中向美國施壓，卻也把北越推向更依賴蘇聯的狀態。區域格局同樣為之重排：寮國與柬埔寨的戰場、北泰邊境的金三角，以及南越崩潰後大批居民外流所引發的船民問題，長期改變了東南亞的人口與政治版圖；日本與澳洲在戰時成為美軍最重要的後勤與轉運基地，澳洲第一梯隊更實際參與實戰，日本與蘇聯在1975年簽署的和平友好條約，常被研究者視為越戰後美蘇在亞洲力量對比改變的指標之一。
impactEn: The war changed far more than Vietnam. For the United States it was a conflict with no quick solution that nevertheless demanded continuous investment, and the anti-war movement of the early 1970s, the publication of the Pentagon Papers in 1971, the move to an all-volunteer force in 1973, the legal argument over whether a commander could issue unlawful orders that grew out of the Fort Hood case of the 1980s, and the long aftermath known as the Vietnam Syndrome all trace directly back to that experience. American doctrine on overseas intervention shifted from comprehensive involvement towards low-intensity, non-war operations and defence in depth, the so-called Weinberger Doctrine. On weapons development, the war drove precision-guided bombs, laser- and television-guided optical pods, the modernisation of drone reconnaissance and joint fire support, while the sheer number of UH-1s turned helicopter operations from an auxiliary into the foundation of army structure. For North and South Vietnam alike, the unification of 1975 did not end the fighting: the Vietnamese advance into Cambodia in 1978 and the war with the United States there led directly to China's defensive counterattack against Vietnam in 1979 and to a long deterioration in Sino-Vietnamese relations. Moscow pressed the United States during the large offensives of 1972 and 1975, and in doing so pushed North Vietnam into still greater dependence on the Soviet Union. The regional map was rearranged as well: the battlefields of Laos and Cambodia, the Golden Triangle along the northern Thai border, and the flight of residents after the collapse of South Vietnam together reshaped the demographic and political landscape of Southeast Asia for decades. Japan and Australia became the most important logistical and staging bases for American forces during the war, with the Australian 1st Task Force actually taking part in operations, and the peace and friendship treaty signed between Japan and the Soviet Union in 1975 is often read by researchers as a marker of the change in the Sino-American balance in Asia after Vietnam.
result: 結果是北越與越共的全面勝利與南越政權的崩解。1973年1月27日巴黎和平協議簽訂，規定美軍在兩個月內撤出、南越與北越停止敵對行動、美軍協助營救戰俘，但協議從未為南越提供有效的軍事保障。1975年春季，北越軍隊在連續攻勢下攻佔邦美蜀、順化與峴港，4月21日胡志明逝世，4月30日西貢陷落，阮文善宣布辭職，南越政府人員乘美軍直升機與船隻撤往各地，7月2日南越與北越合併，越南共和國終結，越南社會主義共和國成立。美軍方面，1973年3月29日最後一批作戰部隊撤出，其後以顧問、軍援與海上搜索救援的名義維持存在，最終在1975年4月完全離開；五萬八千餘名美軍人員的性命與以千億美元計的支出，換來的是一個共產主義國家與一條長期化的邊境戰線。對UH-1而言，這場戰爭既是它的定型戰也是它的普及戰：越南之後，UH-1進入美軍師旅的標準編制，並被數十個國家採用，在南斯拉夫、寮國、柬埔寨、埃塞俄比亞與阿富汗等戰場繼續服役，總產量以萬架計，成為史上使用最廣泛的軍用直升機之一。
resultEn: The result was a comprehensive victory for North Vietnam and the Viet Cong and the collapse of the South Vietnamese state. The Paris Peace Accords were signed on 27 January 1973, providing for the withdrawal of American troops within two months, a halt to hostilities between north and south, and American assistance in recovering prisoners of war, but they never gave South Vietnam an effective military guarantee. In the spring of 1975 North Vietnamese forces took Ban Me Thuot, Hue and Da Nang in a succession of offensives; Ho Chi Minh died on 21 April; Saigon fell on 30 April and Nguyen Van Thieu resigned, with South Vietnamese officials leaving by American helicopter and by sea. On 2 July the two Vietnams were merged, the Republic of Vietnam ceased to exist, and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam was established. On the American side the last combat troops withdrew on 29 March 1973, and the United States then maintained a presence under the names of advisers, military assistance and maritime search and rescue before finally leaving in April 1975. The lives of more than 58,000 Americans and expenditure running into the hundreds of billions bought a communist state and a permanently contested frontier. For the UH-1, the war was both its defining and its popularising campaign: after Vietnam the type entered the standard order of battle of American divisions, was adopted by dozens of countries, and went on serving in Rhodesia, Laos, Cambodia, Ethiopia and Afghanistan, with production counted in tens of thousands, making it one of the most widely used military helicopters in history.
